findings.title: PO QUANTITY validation incomplete - INVALID case never triggers in SHRENO parser
findings.issue: The PO quantity validation checks for missing and negative values but fails to detect non-numeric (invalid) values. When poOrderQtyRaw contains a non-numeric string like 'ABC', it gets parsed to NaN and then set to null on line 435. The check on line 442 becomes `null < 0` which is false, so INVALID PO QUANTITY error is never generated.
findings.plan_requirement: Plan line 93: SHRENO validation table requires 'MISSING PO QUANTITY' / 'INVALID PO QUANTITY' for numeric parsing of PO Order Qty field (column D)
findings.code_evidence:
Line 435: `record.poOrderQty = !isNaN(parseFloat(poOrderQtyRaw)) ? parseFloat(poOrderQtyRaw) : null;`
Line 442: `else if (record.poOrderQty !== null && record.poOrderQty < 0)` - this condition is never true for invalid input because poOrderQty is null when parsing fails
findings.user_visible_consequence: Invalid PO quantities (non-numeric values in column D) are silently accepted as valid records, bypassing validation. Error aggregation in invalidReasons object will not count these as errors, masking data quality issues in the import preview.
